attributes.name: Houndhacker
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+4; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 2d6 and the Slashing trait. If any d6 rolled on this check is a 1, count it as 5, then recharge this card.

Reveal this card to evade your encounter with a monster that has the Animal trait; you may put it on the top or bottom of its location deck.
